purpose: Record source-row existence/content checks and the staging join result for the 6 November cross-window duplicate addendum.

source_verification.method: Fetched the referenced original-batch CSVs from this branch and parsed their headers/data rows. Each referenced location was checked for row existence, subject, topic/subtopic, question stem and correct-option field.
source_verification.important_limit: Existence and broad concept alignment do not by themselves establish an exact semantic duplicate. Some pairs use different figures or question forms within the same skill family; retain/replace decisions still require contextual and qualified subject/syllabus review.
source_verification.row_location_convention: The numbered source row is the physical CSV line number, including the header as line 1; all 56 retain/hold references were checked at that line.
source_verification.qualification: All referenced rows exist and match their recorded subject/topic and broad skill family. This does not convert a skill-family resemblance into an independently approved duplicate disposition; the pairs remain subject to contextual and qualified academic review.

staging_join.result: All 34 new held locations and 34 retained anchors matched the 1 November retained export. The six genuinely new cluster-extension rows were added; two extension locations already held in the baseline were excluded. A separate 6 November staging revision was created and verified. The 1 November baseline remains unchanged.
staging_join.method: Matched source_batch/source_csv_row in baseline retained exports and retained_location/held_location references from the addendum. Verified all 40 per-batch totals remain 40; retained/held source locations are unique and non-overlapping.
